description: Free. Does not count against usage limits. Tell the people who run this server what you were trying to do and what tool or data you wished existed, optionally with a price you would pay. Use this when a tool is missing or an API cannot do what you need. Text is stored so a human can read it; emails, phone numbers and URLs with tokens are stripped.

trying_to_do.description: What you were trying to do (max 1500 characters).

wished_tool_or_data.description: The tool, endpoint or data you wished existed (max 1500 characters).

would_pay.description: Optional. What you would pay, e.g. '0.01 per call' or '$5/month'. Not a payment.

name: tell_us_what_you_need
title: Tell us what you need
